ns2:section.sectionText: MCB 251 section 10 is the MCB Honors section with enrollment also open to James Scholars. Concurrent registration in MCB 290 NCK is required. All other interested students should contact Shawna Naidu at shawna@uiuc.edu for information and approval. Laboratories begin on Monday, August 27, 2007. Examinations will be held on Wednesday evenings from 7-9 PM on October 10, 2006 and November 7, 2007. Enrollment in this course is restricted to sophmores, juniors and seniors. To be considered for an override as a freshman, please contact Deb Bielser at bielser@life.uiuc.edu.
